summary: 55 of 60 pass (92%): cuts 29/30, labels 24/27, retypes 2/3; no fabricated quotes, though two of the catalogued-bridge labels lean on hub lines about a different bridge (Synthesis ↔ Woodworking, Saturation ↔ Stress in Materials) and stand only on the hub's 'This hub catalogs…' line. The duplicate folds (hub spawned vs bridge member-of, spawned vs a said emerged-from or deepens) are sound throughout. The failures share one pattern: the reader checked that a label's words were on a page but not that the type under it says the same thing. Pages as Agents → SCHEMA and Meadows → FOUR PILLARS carry true labels on types pointing the wrong way (deepens and enables swapped). Meadows → Artist's Career keeps a spawned the dates and the project's own 'pivot of' line refute. The Jewel is part of the module's seed, not an instance of the module. The one costly error is the Meadows → Meadows and Music cut: the dates do kill spawned, but the project credits her as author and has a 'Connection to Meadows' in every exercise, so it should be retyped to enables, not cut. Two cuts (Endosymbiosis ↔ Swarm Weave, Granular ↔ Endosymbiosis) finish removing pairs whose other side went in October. They are right on the merits, but Endosymbiosis — Context's claim that Granular states the mirror becomes false and needs a line.
